svg.text: ∇θ L flows back to π through J (G-2 itself is frozen and not differentiable)
no G-2 / MuJoCo at run time
u: ACT command chunk (100 frames, 20 Hz) · δa: correction (≤ 10 mrad, zero during contact) · ω: measured wrist IMU gyro
ω̂: G-2-predicted gyro · ω*: ideal gyro rendered from u · BP: 0.5–9 Hz band-pass · J: G-2's own Jacobian
⚠ All numbers are from the OLD (unstable) table and must be re-measured on the new table.
Robot results: FF and π were each tested alone, in separate sessions; FF + this π together was not tested.
Left inset is schematic; bar values are measured.
